title: thelypteris pygmaea
intro: Thelypteris pygmaea, commonly known as Dwarf Lady Fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the Thelypteridaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris pygmaea are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe and calm irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
